_about: EV-008 live acceptance query set (REQ-008, D-007). Run only through the live acceptance command with the live budget below. Queries were chosen by the assistant to cover the three markets, a specific-model question, and an open-ended question; the owner approves them with plan kensaku-mvp-v1.
runRules: Each suite run starts with an empty cache (the suite bypasses and does not read the 6-hour cache), so every run makes fresh Exa calls.
Every suite run's log is committed under .futari/evidence/live/, including failed and blocked runs.

A second or third run is allowed only after a recorded fix (commit SHA and reason in .futari/evidence/JM-006.md) or after a run recorded as BLOCKED by an Exa outage. The verdict comes from the last run; best-of-N selection is not allowed.

Revalidation is a self-consistency check: each displayed offer is reclassified from the recorded Exa response and must equal what the UI showed. It detects display or pipeline mutation, not extraction errors; the owner audit covers those.

thresholds.displayedOffersPassingOwnerAudit: at least 90% of all displayed offers across the run, each audited by the owner as the right product on a direct merchant page

auditRubric: Right product: the merchant page sells the candidate model (a colour variant counts; a different model or a bundle does not).
Direct merchant: the URL is the merchant's own product page, not a review, aggregator, or search page.
Price display: the shown price, currency, and availability equal the values Exa returned for that URL in this run, as recorded in the run log.
